# 50s cartoon — Style Prompt

> 1950s limited animation for "follow along" films: colour printed a few pixels off its broken ink line, a presenter whose body holds still while the hands do the work, abstract colour-plane rooms under a sunburst, round call-outs and numbered discs, caption cards with little stars.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

Flat, printed-looking colour with a thin ink line that never quite closes. **Every fill is a separate "cel" printed a few px off its line** (about 6 px right, 4 px down), and that offset re-rolls on twos (12 fps), so the picture shimmers like hand-registered paint. Light paper tooth, warm vignette.

People and things are geometric: an egg head whose nose is part of the outline, a sweater in the brand's main colour, trousers in a dark shade of the accent, cream gloves. **The presenter's body is a held drawing: only arms, hands and mouth animate.** A room is never drawn: a scene is one colour plane, a darker floor band, a horizon line with gaps, and one or two props.

Not the 1930s rubber-hose cartoon (no bouncing world), not a whiteboard explainer (it shows *how to do*, not *why*), not a smooth vector animation: pictures are printed, not drawn live.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Two cels per shape**: a colour fill offset by `(--jx, --jy)` (about 5–8 px, 3–6 px; new values every 1/12 s) and an ink outline in place on top. Text carries a second colour plate the same way (a text-shadow in a mix of the main colour and ground).
- **Line**: 4 px ink, round caps, broken (dash pattern about 150/7, 90/5, 210/9 px); the gaps are deliberate. Thin 3 px lines for louvres and mesh.
- **Shading**: one flat darker plane per shape, no gradients. Where a shadow is needed use a copy offset down-right.
- **Ornaments**: 30-wedge sunburst (cream at ~30 %, turning ≤ 14° over the film), 4-point sparkles, 16-point starburst, polka dots.
- **Paper**: one pre-painted overlay of dry-brush flecks and light flecks plus a warm vignette; never animated.

## 3. Colour logic

- **`--latar`** is the first ground (a warm yellow in its own colours), **`--latar-2`** the step ground (powder blue), **`--aksen`** a third ground block and the trousers' base. **`--utama`** is the presenter's sweater, kicker stars and call-out accents; it never fills the product.
- **Fixed**: paper cream (`--kertas`, cards, gloves, product), ink (`--tinta`, lines, discs, pills), skin and hair. The product keeps one colour through the whole film; ground colours rotate around it.
- Words on a ground use `--teks`/`--teks-di-aksen`; on cream cards, ink. Nothing is neon or pure.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul`: Archivo Black (slab-like weight) for titles, numerals, headers: 100–150 px at 1920, with its offset colour plate. `--font-isi`: Poppins 500 for captions, tags and labels, 34–40 px. A script kicker (Caveat 700, ~118 px) writes on from the left in 9 steps.
- **Caption card**: cream rounded slab, 4 px ink border, stars at the ends, bottom-centre, ~40 px, fades in with a 24 px rise; hold ≥ max(1.8 s, chars/12 + 1 s).
- **Step header**: ink disc (96 px) with a cream numeral, spaced 22 px "LANGKAH n DARI N", title beside it; slides in on twos.

## 5. Motion quality

- **On twos**: poses, arm swings (`steps(5)` over 0.3–0.5 s), the register jitter and falling dust (`steps(6)`) change at about 12 fps. Camera-like moves (iris, wipe, sunburst turn) are smooth.
- **Held body, moving hands**: one arm action per beat: lift, point or cheer, 0.3–0.5 s, landing on the beat; mouth flaps `steps(1)` at 0.17 s.
- **Pop-ins**: pills, tags, medallions, starbursts scale from 0.2 with `back.out(2.4)` over 0.3–0.5 s.
- **Transitions**: circle iris from the object (0.7 s), colour-block wipe from below (0.6 s), cuts on a beat; no dissolves.
- **Endings**: dead still for ≥ 2 s; nothing twinkles after the last hold begins (the jitter alone continues).

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera is "the stand", never handheld.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Iris from the object | The thing *is* the door | the first step; a change of rule |
| Round call-out with leader line | Context and detail at once | a fault; a small part; a result |
| Colour-block wipe from below | Turning the manual's page | a price; a tip; a summary |
| Slow sunburst turn | Quiet life behind a still frame | a title; a closing |
| Pop of a starburst | The number is the star | a price; a count; a promise |
| Dead still ≥ 2 s | The frame to screenshot | a call to action; a result |

Key subjects stay ≥ 1/3 of frame height and clear of the caption band (bottom 130 px).

## 7. Native moves

- **Off-register colour** makes a plain card hand-made and warm. *Fits content like:* a shop's opening hours; a museum's rules; a recipe card; a bedtime story.
- **Held figure, moving hand**: the hand *is* the step. *Fits content like:* cleaning a filter; threading a machine; setting a thermostat; a teacher at a board.
- **The round call-out** is the close-up, with the detail inside. *Fits content like:* a dust-clogged mesh; a dosage on a cup; a torque value; a leaf's vein.
- **The starburst figure**: the number stamps in on a 16-point star. *Fits content like:* a service price; a class fee; a challenge's day count; a score.
- **Numbered disc and step header** open each step. *Fits content like:* a how-to; a safety card; a creator's three tips; a rules list.

## 8. Pitfalls

- A presenter who walks or bounces breaks the held body: move arms and mouth only.
- Fill and line perfectly aligned reads as clean vector: keep the offset on everything, switch it off only for a crisp diagram.
- Gradients inside shapes: use one flat darker plane instead.
- Zooming the picture triples the ink: put close-ups in call-out circles instead.
- Caption cards without reading time: give chars/12 + 1 s.
- Text on the colour plate only: the ink or ground-contrast plate must carry the reading; the offset plate is decoration.

# 50s cartoon: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3.2, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: sunburst over a colour plane, product in a cream disc, presenter held still with one arm cheering; kicker script writes on twos
- id: sinar matahari di bidang warna, produk dalam cakram krem, tokoh diam dengan satu tangan terangkat; tulisan skrip muncul patah-patah

## problem

- en: the same held figure; the fault is a round call-out close-up with dust falling on twos, a leader line tying it to the object
- id: tokoh yang sama diam; masalahnya jadi kaca pembesar bulat dengan debu jatuh patah-patah, garis penunjuk ke bendanya

## fact

- en: a paper tag with a star bullet pops with a back-ease beside the call-out; the hand points on the beat, data lands on the picture
- id: kartu kertas berbintang muncul membal di samping kaca pembesar; tangan menunjuk pas ketukan, data menempel di gambar

## step

- en: ink disc with a numeral, spaced 'STEP n OF N' and a plated title slide in on twos; a colour-block ground, the hand does the step
- id: cakram tinta berangka, 'LANGKAH n DARI N' dan judul berplat masuk patah-patah; latar blok warna, tangan yang melakukan langkahnya

## compare

- en: frame split in two colour blocks, wrong on one side and right on the other, the same held figure and a call-out each
- id: bingkai dibelah dua blok warna, salah di satu sisi dan benar di sisi lain, tokoh sama diam dengan kaca pembesar masing-masing

## number

- en: a 16-point cream starburst stamps in with a back-ease and carries the figure in slab type; colour-block wipe from below
- id: bintang krem 16 titik terstempel membal dan memuat angkanya dalam huruf tebal; sapuan blok warna dari bawah

## proof

- en: a clean-result close-up in a round call-out, drops washing the dirt off on twos, then four-point sparkles twinkle
- id: hasil bersih dalam kaca pembesar bulat, tetes air membasuh kotoran patah-patah, lalu kilau empat titik berkelip

## offer

- en: the price or deal sits in a starburst or an ink-bordered pill, popped on the beat, the presenter pointing to it
- id: harga atau tawaran di bintang atau pil bertepi tinta, muncul pas ketukan, tokoh menunjuk ke arahnya

## cta

- en: circle iris to a sunburst ground, kicker script, slab call to action, a contact pill popped last; then dead still for 2 s or more
- id: iris lingkaran ke latar sinar matahari, skrip kecil, ajakan huruf tebal, pil kontak muncul terakhir; lalu diam total 2 detik lebih

## payoff

- en: the finished object in its cream disc, sparkles twinkling once, the presenter's arms up; the iris closes and everything holds still
- id: bendanya selesai di cakram krem, kilau berkelip sekali, tokoh mengangkat tangan; iris menutup lalu semuanya diam

    <style>

      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */

    <script>
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
      let seed = 4848;
      const rnd = () => { seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      // Satu bentuk = sel warna (bergeser) + garis tinta putus-putus di atasnya.
      const part = (d, fill, cls = "") => `<g class="cel"><path d="${d}" style="fill:${fill}" /></g><path class="ink ${cls}" d="${d}" />`;
      const rr = (x, y, w, h, r) => `M${x + r} ${y}H${x + w - r}Q${x + w} ${y} ${x + w} ${y + r}V${y + h - r}Q${x + w} ${y + h} ${x + w - r} ${y + h}H${x + r}Q${x} ${y + h} ${x} ${y + h - r}V${y + r}Q${x} ${y} ${x + r} ${y}Z`;
      // Sinar matahari 1950-an: 30 baji.
      function sunburst(el) {
        let d = "";
        for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
          const a = (i * 12 * Math.PI) / 180, b = a + (6 * Math.PI) / 180;
          d += `M1300 1300L${1300 + Math.cos(a) * 1900} ${1300 + Math.sin(a) * 1900}L${1300 + Math.cos(b) * 1900} ${1300 + Math.sin(b) * 1900}Z`;
        }
        el.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 2600 2600");
        el.innerHTML = `<path d="${d}" />`;
        el.style.transformOrigin = "1300px 1300px";
      }
      // Kilau empat titik.
      const spark = (x, y, r) => `<path class="sp" d="M${x} ${y - r}L${x + r * 0.16} ${y - r * 0.16}L${x + r} ${y}L${x + r * 0.16} ${y + r * 0.16}L${x} ${y + r}L${x - r * 0.16} ${y + r * 0.16}L${x - r} ${y}L${x - r * 0.16} ${y - r * 0.16}Z" style="fill:var(--kertas);transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center" />`;
      // AC dinding: badan kertas, celah angin, sirip bawah, layar aksen.
      function ac(host, dirty) {
        host.innerHTML = `<svg width="700" height="260" viewBox="0 0 700 260" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0">
          ${part(rr(10, 10, 680, 150, 36), "var(--kertas)")}${part(rr(30, 140, 640, 52, 24), "var(--kertas-2)")}
          <path class="ink" d="M60 52H520M60 78H520M60 104H520" style="stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:none;opacity:.7" />

      }
      // Tokoh: badan diam; lengan dua ruas (bahu, siku) yang digerakkan GSAP.
      function presenter(host, id) {
        const arm = (sx, k) => `<g id="${id}${k}u">${part(`M${sx - 12} 165h24v72h-24z`, "var(--utama)")}<g id="${id}${k}f">${part(`M${sx - 10} 235h20v58h-20z`, "var(--utama)")}${part(`M${sx - 16} 290Q${sx - 22} 322 ${sx - 4} 330Q${sx + 18} 328 ${sx + 16} 296Z`, "var(--kertas)")}</g></g>`;
        host.innerHTML = `<svg width="352" height="572" viewBox="0 0 320 520" style="overflow:visible">
          ${arm(206, "b")}${part("M108 270L100 490H138L148 290L160 290L168 490H206L198 270Z", "var(--celana)")}
          ${part("M100 150Q150 140 202 150L208 282H94Z", "var(--utama)")}<path d="M94 262H208" style="stroke:var(--tinta);stroke-width:14;fill:none" />
          <ellipse cx="116" cy="494" rx="34" ry="10" style="fill:var(--tinta)" /><ellipse cx="186" cy="494" rx="34" ry="10" style="fill:var(--tinta)" />
